parameters.query:
INSERT INTO municipio (geocode, nome, uf, regiao, geom, centroid)
SELECT
  (r->>'geocode')::bigint,
  r->>'nome',
  r->>'uf',
  r->>'regiao',
  ST_Multi(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(r->>'geomJson'), 4326)),
  ST_Centroid(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(r->>'geomJson'), 4326))
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) r
ON CONFLICT (geocode) DO UPDATE
SET nome     = EXCLUDED.nome,
    uf       = EXCLUDED.uf,
    regiao   = EXCLUDED.regiao,
    geom     = EXCLUDED.geom,
    centroid = EXCLUDED.centroid;
